## Historical audit: H0177

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane2/codex_parallel_12_lane2_shared/hint_gen/ink-grid-box-layout/trajs.json`. All event citations below refer to this file. This is a **teacher-only guidance trace**, not a student implementation trace.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | Inferred from the inspected reference and guide: add grid layout to Ink’s `Box`, including tracks, placement and rendering. The original task prompt is not visible, so its exact requirements cannot be independently reconstructed. Existing styles expose `flex` and `none`; the teacher inspected a reference diff proposing grid support (main_agent events 2 and 8, characters [0,35845) and [0,44556)). |
| Exploration | The teacher independently read the reference diff and repository layout, style, DOM, reconciler, rendering and test files. The search for layout flow returned useful matches but exited 2 because `tests` did not exist (events 6–10; event 10, [0,5519)). Reading existing tests was inspection, not test execution (event 23, [0,3703)). |
| Detection and diagnosis | The teacher identified the display mapping and renderer integration as relevant, and flagged potential sizing, partial-placement and stale Yoga-state issues. The reference code itself shows fixed-max tracks each receiving the same `remaining` value and partially specified placements defaulting the other axis to zero; these are code-based concerns, not observed runtime failures (events 2 and 27, [0,35845) and [0,7858)). |
| Proposed versus executed | The guide proposed a grid pass, placement and sizing work, renderer integration and regression tests. These were recommendations, not executed repository changes. The sole visible write created `/tmp/hint_output.md`; the tool confirmed creation (events 25–26, [0,7915) and [0,7818)). The final response states that repository changes were prohibited and none were made (event 27, [0,7858)). The nonempty reference diff was **read**, not applied; an empty `structuredPatch` on the guide-file creation is not evidence of an implementation patch. |
| Outcome and adoption | The teacher session formally completed successfully (top_level_metadata, [0,11812)); this establishes completion of the guidance session, not correctness of grid layout. No test run, implementation evaluation, student receipt or adoption is visible. The search error was a limited tool error, not a terminal interruption. Implementation outcome is **unknown**, not proven success, partial correctness or algorithm failure. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, tracing data from public types through layout and output allocation exposes integration risks that a type-only change can miss. Task-specific hypotheses include fixed-max space allocation, one-axis placement, nested grids and stale absolute positions after updates; the guide recommended tests, but none were run here (event 27, [0,7858)). Whether those concerns manifest, whether the guide was delivered to a student, and whether any later implementation worked remain unresolved. Scene-specific object, material, pose, camera and lighting checks are not applicable to this code trace.
